content.content: The file /tmp/avb-Xd1p3V/project/site/css/tokens.css has been updated successfully.

content.text:
The site's custom font wasn't loading, so every page fell back to a different system font. That's why everything looked different.

**Cause:** In `site/css/tokens.css:5`, the font rule pointed to `../font/acme-sans.woff2`, but the folder is named `site/fonts/`. The server returned a 404 for the font file, so every page used the fallback. The visual check flagged this on all 12 snapshots (6 pages × desktop/phone) as "web font 'Acme Sans' failed to load".

**Fix:** I changed the path to `../fonts/acme-sans.woff2`.

**Result:** After the fix, all 28 tests pass, functional and visual. All 12 visual snapshots now match the approved baselines, so the site looks as it did before. I didn't approve any baselines or change any; none needed updating.

The repo history has only the initial commit, so I couldn't see which change broke the path. The 404 makes the cause clear anyway. The fix isn't committed yet; tell me if you want me to commit it.

STATUS: DONE
